objective: Frozen new-seed broader check of the unchanged cash-source ablation and selector, on 12 opponent packages. Report branch financial failures and realized choice quality against the cash-splice selector, demand and old_model. This does not establish conditional compatibility with the observed rival farm.
decision: Keep all losses and uncompiled/unfunded cases. A positive result against the cash-splice selector alone is insufficient for broader pipeline promotion; compare the existing demand and old_model choices and declared tail/group limits.
implementation: Same own purchase repair and original three-course chooser. The only valuation change is retaining source rival cash instead of splicing observed current rival cash into historical resources. Historical worlds are explicit stress cases; no extra cash is given to actual played opponents.
